_doc: SPECIAL ABILITIES (Q). Each weapon names one via its 'special' field. type = spin | cleave | blink | quake | lunge (handled in scripts/actors/player.gd).

spin.name: Performance Review
spin.description: Whirl around, striking every enemy nearby.

cleave.name: Budget Cleave
cleave.description: A huge frontal cleave that sends enemies flying.

blink.name: Unscheduled Visit
blink.description: Teleport toward the cursor and land a guaranteed critical strike.

quake.name: Order in the Office
quake.description: Slam the floor, damaging and stunning everything around you.

lunge.name: Deadline Rush
lunge.description: Dash forward, piercing every enemy in your path.
